## Review remediation (2026-08-21)

- Scope named `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verifier.md`, which does not exist; the Pass-2 code-review prompt is `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md`.
- The plan injected standing items from `finalize.py`, which by its own module docstring (`finalize.py:1-9`) runs only *after* the four-pass workflow returns a terminal verdict — Pass-2 is over by then, so injection moved to the `merge_findings` step (`workflow_ops.py:226`), matching plan-review's post-Pass-1 seam at `plan_review/pass1.py:373-374`.
- The plan filtered prior findings by a `disposition` field; no review finding carries one, and the code-review payload has no flat `findings` key either — it stores `blocking`/`advisory`/`dropped`/`indeterminate`/`coaching` buckets (`sidecar.py:94-113`), so the state is introduced as a new additive `standing` sub-object and the prior set is filtered surfaced-only.
- Scope and Testing cited `tests/unit/llm/code_review/…`; neither `tests/unit/llm/` nor that package exists — code-review tests are flat under `tests/unit/` (`test_code_review_artifact.py`, `test_code_review_region_gate.py`, `test_code_review_finalize.py`, `test_code_review_ws4.py`), and `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py` is correct as written.
- The plan asserted that keeping a finding's criterion and posture means "no new blocks arise from carry-forward alone"; `pass3_decide` recomputes `decision` every run from `blocking_enabled` + `priority ≥ block_threshold` (`decide.py:653, :730`) with the threshold re-resolved per criterion, and on change 1867 the same defect changed criterion between patch sets — so the posture is now an explicit clamp in `code_review_decide`, not an assumption.
- Two further corrections folded into the text: the verifier's finding listing is built by `review_kernel.verify_instructions` (`verify.py:114`), which plan-review shares (`plan_review/passes.py:66`), so the standing-item wording stays code-review-local; and the Gerrit "since patchset k" text is rendered in `review_bot/finding_publish.py:126,:147`, not in `adapter.py`, whose `_translate_findings` (`adapter.py:122`) drops every key outside `{severity, dimension, detail, location}`.

- E2/T8 (no classification procedure; `withdrawn` had no trigger): the description now states one assignment rule per state, each keyed to a named signal — `still-present` = REGION_UNCHANGED or REGION_UNKNOWN, `addressed` = REGION_CHANGED, `withdrawn` = the prior item already carried a `standing` object — plus a worked PS2->PS4 example (the reviewer's 'specification by example' coaching move).
- G6 (merge_findings cannot compute the state): confirmed against the tree — merge_findings (workflow_ops.py:237) receives only finding lists via the code-review.yaml merge step, which wires base/round_a/round_b findings and nothing else. Classification moved to a new leaf llm/code_review/carry_forward.py, which holds the prior payload's `deps` map and calls region_gate.region_for_finding; merge_findings now receives already-resolved items as data through a new optional `standing_findings` workflow input.
- G6 (no termination argument vs plan-review's material-changed guard): `addressed` is the per-finding analogue of _material_changed (plan_review/sidecar.py:396) and `withdrawn` makes the carry ONE-SHOT, so the chain terminates after a single patchset even when the cited region keeps churning.
- Advisory (unresolvable signal has no fallback; STANDING_CAP unspecified): REGION_UNKNOWN defaults to `still-present` — safe because the posture clamp means a carried item can only lower a decision — and STANDING_CAP is pinned at 12, matching plan-review's RECALL_CAP (plan_review/sidecar.py:368).
- Verified against the tree while remediating: the memory key is only available at gate_dispatch._assemble_code_review_run / finalize (request.session_id / request.change_id), which is why resolution happens there rather than inside the workflow; region_for_finding is file-content-hash granularity (region_gate.py:31-43), so no line-level 'cited lines deleted' claim survives in the plan; test stubs monkeypatch rebar.llm.code_review.sidecar.latest_code_review_result BY STRING at test_code_review_region_gate.py:85,:183,:201 and test_code_review_gate_session.py:484, so the reader's added `revision` key must be added to those stubs.

Plan-review remediation round 3, against review rv10 (BLOCK; 1 blocking T8 + 5 advisory).

- BLOCKING T8 (origin_decision undefined): correct — the reader unions blocking+advisory into one list, so a consumer could not tell a prior BLOCK from a prior ADVISORY. Fixed in code and plan: latest_code_review_result now stamps each surfaced item with the bucket it came from (blocking->block, advisory->advisory); standing_items copies that into standing.origin_decision, falling back to the item's own `decision` then to `advisory`, so the clamp can never invent a blocking posture.
- E4 advisory (critical): my '_assemble_code_review_run is the only site holding session_id/change_id' claim was refuted by the snapshot — CodeReviewRequest carries both and is threaded to _run_code_review_gate/finalize too. Reworded: items resolve PRE-workflow in _assemble because that is where the workflow inputs are built, and the two sites now share ONE key rule via a new sidecar.memory_key that also replaces the key composition finalize.py open-coded.
- E1/E6 advisory (critical): the dispatcher wiring had no AC. Added test_carried_findings_reach_only_the_post_pass1_merge_input in test_code_review_gate_session.py (asserts standing_findings is populated from the reader AND that the carried text appears in no finder-facing input) and an AC citing it.
- T8 advisory (coverage): correct — the assembly-site coverage sink is not the signed coverage the coach step builds. The plan no longer claims per-state counts land in the signed coverage.
- E6 advisory (unanchored grep): 'standing' also matches 'understanding'. The AC now greps -Eci 'standing finding|carried from an earlier patchset'.

Implementation status: code, tests and gates are green in the worktree — make lint, make typecheck, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, all touched src/rebar files under the 800-line cap (workflow_ops.py 784, new carry_forward.py 215). Every new test was mutation-checked: 13 perturbations (flip the region->state mapping, drop the already-carried check, drop the grounded-only filter, drop the cap, skip the merge injection, inject a re-emitted item, no-op the clamp, blank the verify note, drop the Gerrit suffix, drop the adapter passthrough, drop the reader's revision key, ignore the origin_decision stamp, stamp both buckets the same) each turned a specific test RED.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

A sidecar payload is keyed by `(change_id, revision)` and Gerrit emits one `code_review` artifact
per revision (`review_bot/artifact_emit.py:84`), so a finding raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on the
next reaches no consumer. On change 1867 the `assert elapsed < 10` advisory ran on PS1-PS2 and
vanished on PS3-PS4, which merged `LLM-Review+1` with zero findings; the defect then broke macOS CI
on 1869 (bug `9bb7-4430-1202-4d93`). Recall is non-deterministic per run. Existing memory only
NARROWS: `apply_region_gated_floor` (`workflow_ops.py:641`) reads `latest_code_review_result`
(`sidecar.py:354`) to drop findings, never to re-raise one.

## Approach

Mirror plan-review's recall backstop (`plan_review/sidecar.py:414`, injected at `pass1.py:489`) — no
second mechanism. Paths omit `src/rebar/`.

- **Where state is computed.** New leaf `llm/code_review/carry_forward.py`. `standing_items(key, *,
  repo_root, coverage=None)` reads the prior payload via `latest_code_review_result` (extended to
  also return `revision`, the origin patchset) and classifies each item with
  `region_gate.region_for_finding(f, prior_deps, repo_root=…)` (`region_gate.py:31`) against that
  payload's `deps` hash map. Classification lives HERE, not in `merge_findings`
  (`workflow_ops.py:237`), which sees only finding lists and no deps; merge gets resolved items as data.
- **Eligibility.** Surfaced-only — the reader unions `blocking` + `advisory` only;
  widening it would let a permanently dropped finding back in (bug `old-frilly-plankton`). Grounded-only — empty `evidence` is ineligible: the verifier
  would be confirming a bare assertion (bug `deceitful-flannel-jerboa`). Highest `priority` first, capped at
  `STANDING_CAP = 12` (plan-review's `RECALL_CAP`).
- **State — one rule per value**, on a new additive `standing` object `{origin_revision,
  origin_decision, state}` (no `disposition` field today). `origin_decision` comes from the reader,
  which now stamps each surfaced item with the BUCKET it came from (`blocking`->`block`,
  `advisory`->`advisory`; the union erases that boundary), falling back to the item's own
  `decision`, then `advisory` — the clamp never invents a blocking posture:
  - `still-present` — cited file's hash == the prior review's (`REGION_UNCHANGED`), or the signal
    is unresolvable (`REGION_UNKNOWN`: multi-file, absent path, error). CARRIED; UNKNOWN defaults
    here deliberately, since the clamp means carrying can only lower a posture.
  - `addressed` — cited file's content differs (`REGION_CHANGED`): the edit is evidence it was
    acted on, so the fresh finder's silence rules. NOT carried.
  - `withdrawn` — the item ITSELF carries a `standing` object: already carried once. NOT carried.
  Example: PS2 raises `security` at `a.py:40`; PS3 leaves `a.py` byte-identical and does not
  re-emit it → `still-present`, injected into PS3. PS4 edits `a.py` → `addressed`; had PS4 left it
  untouched and still missed it, PS3's carried item is `withdrawn`.
- **Termination (anti-ratchet).** plan-review suppresses recall wholesale on changed material
  (`_material_changed`, `sidecar.py:396`); `addressed` is the per-finding analogue and `withdrawn`
  bounds the rest — an item is carried AT MOST ONCE, so the chain ends after one patchset. Per-state counts go to the caller's optional sink, not the signed `coverage`.
- **Injection.** Post-Pass-1, NOT `finalize.py` (its docstring `:1-9`: post-verdict only).
  Items resolve in `gate_dispatch._assemble_code_review_run` (`:401` — where the workflow inputs
  are built; `finalize.py` holds the same ids, so both share ONE rule via a new
  `sidecar.memory_key`; `session:<id>` local / `change:<id>` Gerrit, no CI trigger), pass
  as a new optional `standing_findings` workflow input, and
  `merge_findings` appends those whose `norm_id` fresh Pass-1 did not produce. They reach
  `code_review_verify_inputs` (`workflow_ops.py:270`); finders never see them.
- **Shared kernel: no behaviour change.** `verify_instructions` (`verify.py:114`) builds the
  listing and **plan-review also calls it** (`plan_review/passes.py:66`), so standing wording is
  appended code-review-locally in `code_review_verify_inputs` and in `code-review-verify.md`;
  `verify.py` changes only `prior_findings_block`'s now-wrong docstring claim (`:435`).
- **Posture clamp.** `pass3_decide` RECOMPUTES `decision` every run as "BLOCK
  iff blocking_enabled AND priority >= block_threshold" (`decide.py:631`), threshold resolved per
  criterion (`registry.py:535`), and on 1867 the defect changed criterion between patchsets — so
  `code_review_decide` clamps a `standing` finding to at most `standing.origin_decision`. The floor
  is unaffected: a standing item matches a prior finding, so `rising_floor_drop` (`decide.py:105`) sees low
  novelty and cannot drop it.


## Scope

New: `llm/code_review/carry_forward.py` (home for `STANDING_CAP`, the states, `standing_items()`,
the wrapper text and the clamp — `workflow_ops.py` is 758 LOC against the 800 cap) and
`tests/unit/test_code_review_carry_forward.py`.

Edited as above: `llm/code_review/sidecar.py` (reader + `memory_key`), `.../workflow_ops.py`,
`.../finalize.py` (adopts `memory_key`), `llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml`,
`llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`, `llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md`,
`llm/review_kernel/verify.py` (docstring only), `review_bot/adapter.py` (`_translate_findings`
`:122` drops keys outside `{severity, dimension, detail, location}` — carry `standing`) and
`review_bot/finding_publish.py` (`:126`/`:147` render "since patchset k" — the Gerrit text is
composed there, not in `adapter.py`).

`test_code_review_region_gate.py` / `test_code_review_gate_session.py` stub the reader **by
string** — update those stubs too.

## Acceptance Criteria

Each runs from the repo root and exits 0, after `CF=tests/unit/test_code_review_carry_forward.py`.

- [ ] `standing_items`/`STANDING_CAP` import from `rebar.llm.code_review.carry_forward`, and ineligible prior items yield nothing (`dropped` bucket, empty `evidence`, no prior review): `pytest $CF -k ineligible -q`.
- [ ] Each state's rule is pinned (incl. the unresolvable-region default) and carry is one-shot — an already-carried item classifies `withdrawn`, uncarried: `pytest $CF -k "state_classification or withdrawn" -q`.
- [ ] A `still-present` item absent from fresh Pass-1 is injected carrying `standing.state` + `standing.origin_revision`: `pytest $CF -k merge_injects_standing -q`.
- [ ] `standing.origin_decision` is taken from the prior surfaced bucket and defaults to advisory: `pytest $CF -k origin_decision -q`.
- [ ] Carry-forward never raises a posture, incl. over a `blocking_enabled` criterion past its `block_threshold`: `pytest $CF -k posture_clamp -q`.
- [ ] The reader exposes `revision` and the per-item origin bucket: `pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py -k latest_code_review_result -q`, with both assertions added.
- [ ] The dispatcher threads carried items into the workflow finder-blind, and convergence is not regressed: `pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_gate_session.py tests/unit/test_code_review_region_gate.py -q`.
- [ ] The shared kernel is untouched beyond a docstring: `git diff origin/main -- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py` shows docstring lines only; `pytest tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py -q`.
- [ ] Gerrit marks carried findings and the prompt names them: `grep -Eci "standing finding|carried from an earlier patchset" src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md` and `grep -c "since patchset" src/rebar/review_bot/finding_publish.py` each return >= 1; `pytest tests/unit/test_review_bot.py -q`.
- [ ] Repo gates hold: `make lint` (which runs `check_complexity_baseline.py --check`: no `new`/`increased`); every touched `src/rebar` file is within `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.
